requirements.title: One coherent typed graph over records whose authorities remain distinct
Visibility, immutability and integrity enforced in the database
An unbound access context reads nothing
Every record names its authority; a mirror is distinguishable from the original
Every controlled write is an attributed act in the transaction that applies it
Every refusal carries a named code and a detail object
Where a check cannot be performed, refuse; a gate that compared nothing fails
An allocated identifier is never reissued; a retired namespace stays resolvable
Withdrawal, supersession, revocation and unpublication are state changes, not deletes
Every digest is over an RFC 8785 canonical form under a named format tag
A generated artifact is reproducible, and a difference fails the build
A known gap is recorded somewhere enumerable, never as an inline marker
The human-only acts are refused to a service actor by name
No generic authenticated write path accepting a caller-supplied action type
External content is admitted one named item at a time, never by container sync
The ontology preserves every approved R01 definition and declares every addition
One package opens connections; one package provides the controlled write path
Every governed record has exactly one object row carrying its governed fields
Event time and record time are separate, and record time is server-assigned
An enterprise identifier is opaque and carries an error-detecting check character
The allocation request has no field for a caller-supplied identifier
Every act names a live acting role assignment, verified first
Only a human person carries an external authentication identity
Classification is a closed, totally ordered set compared by rank
A requested ceiling is resolved against recorded clearance before it is bound
Clearance is organization-scoped and effective-dated; the session ceiling is at most the clearance, and an assignment ceiling caps only its role's grant
Read authorization is row visibility intersected with live grant coverage
Live grants for one principal, scope and capability do not overlap in time
The read path and the write path consult the same grant view
Any access decision is explainable as a path to the deciding grant, exclusion, principal-kind bar or separation-of-duty rule
An institutional act requires an act grant reaching every locked target
Which actions are institutional is declared in the ontology and consulted by the database, not encoded in control flow
Automated work acts as a declared service actor through the same write path
A service actor is refused every institutional act, whatever grants reach it
An act that judges another act is refused to the actor who performed it
Authentication establishes only the subject; authorization comes from the database
A fixed-identity profile is unreachable by configuration from a serving profile
All controlled writes pass one dispatcher, one transaction per act
Authority resolves before materialization; coverage is asserted after locking
Targets lock in canonical order; an invisible target is refused
A stale expected row version is refused
A refused act raises; the result type cannot represent a refusal
A retried act applies at most once; the replayed result is re-read from state
The idempotency digest covers semantics only, excluding transport and read scope
A replay re-verifies the prior act's audit receipt before returning it
Every act appends one audit event, by one implementation, in the same transaction
The audit chain is independently verifiable
External side effects are driven from a durable record written inside the act
A rehearsal uses the real write path in a transaction that cannot commit
A bootstrap act still extends the audit chain, and is enumerable
An undeclared type, state or action token fails a referential constraint
Each schema names one authority; a derived schema is reconstructible
One role may change schema, and it is not the application role
Row-level security is forced, not merely enabled, on governed tables
A table brought under row-level security is statically discoverable
A predicate refactored for plan shape preserves visibility and uses invoker rights
Load-bearing planner settings are identical across environments, and gated
A record asserting an event is immutable but for later verification fields
Every declared invariant is enforced, and the mapping is asserted by a test
Schema changes are ordered and applied from one declared sequence
An irreversible migration is identified as such and offers no false safe path
A fresh install verifies the seeded ontology by digest and refuses a mismatch
An artifact version is immutable; a change produces a new version
Content is addressed by digest, and the producing toolchain is recorded
Ingestion requires an explicit copy-or-reference intent
An external artifact can be recorded by digest and locator without its bytes
Object writes are create-only; a failed act leaves no unreferenced content
A version's bytes may exist in several stores, each with role and verification
A fallback read serves only a copy whose digest has been verified
Replication and verification are recorded acts; a failure is recorded
A parse records the executable identity of its tool, not only the data format
A cross-host golden is frozen only over measured agreement
Conversion loss is enumerated and recorded with the parse
A controlled document's effective state changes only by institutional act
Compilation is deterministic and addressed by digest
The preservation inventory is closed; an omitted governed table fails a gate
An export imported into an empty database re-exports byte-identically
Restore is exercised on a schedule using the shipped scripts
A person can obtain the complete set of records about them they may see
A master record's identity is its corpus; an unchanged corpus replays
Staleness is computed by comparing the corpus, or shown absent by the database's record of input writes since the compilation's snapshot, never asserted by the writer
Every reading is a declared projection whose members subset the corpus
Projection sections cover the corpus with an explicit remainder
Agent context is a projection under the same invariants as a human reading
The projection grammar is closed, non-executable and statically bounded
Every object type has a read view derived from ontology metadata
Every governed table carries a boundary classification; unclassified fails
No external system is resolved live into a master record
A compiled record enumerates what was withheld and on what basis
One search index for all audiences, filtered by the same context at read time
Allocation is atomic with its act, skips occupied numbers, refuses unknown namespaces
An act can return a computed value read back from durable state, stable on replay
KF is institutional authority without becoming Source Holder, and records their digests
A federated record's identity here is the identity its Source Holder uses
Publication writes exactly one verified public copy; the database refuses others
Unpublication is a recorded state change over the copy, never a delete
An external copy records the source, the exact revision, and any converter
A conversion impossible at the cited revision is refused, not relabelled
A federation adapter creates no writable local copy that could diverge
The product is separable from one deployment's registry; couplings are recorded
Model lineage is append-only and holds measurements, not underlying data
Secure-object access is by issued, recorded capability with a declared purpose
The work-control path is reachable through declared actions alone
Product, quality and engineering records use the same model, with no privileged path
The HTTP layer holds no authority and permits nothing the write path refuses; its own refusals are admission checks that grant nothing
Operator commands take secrets by file only, refusing an inline secret by name
A release package carries its gaps, and an approval commits to them
A manifest does not contain its own digest; verifying it is a distinct act
Approved definitions preserved, additions declared, divergences exhaustive
A rule that cannot be machine-enforced is recorded as such
Generated artifacts contain nothing non-deterministic and are verified by rebuild
The presentation layer contains no authority decision or business rule
Every canonical format carries a version tag inside its digest preimage
One declared platform contract, stated rather than implied
Every host requirement is stated and probed, on a minimal image
The artifact tested is the artifact deployed; installation is atomic and reversible
Each service runs under a distinct unprivileged account
The alert path is exercised on a schedule and its delivery evidenced
A backup is verified at its destination and restore proven on a schedule
An archiving command fails on a write it did not perform
Checkpoint signing runs where the serving application cannot reach the key
Commissioning requires host evidence; availability is not authorisation
Controls no automated check covers are enumerated as such
Every documented control cites an artifact, and a gate verifies the path resolves
Claims needing host, provider or human evidence are outstanding until it exists
This specification is governed by digest; accepted revisions are immutable
Every copy states the revision and digest it reproduces, and presents no revision as accepted that its record does not
Decisions record measurement and rejected options; superseded records are retained
Requirement identifiers are append-only; status is derived from evidence
A cross-repository requirement citation is unverified until a tool resolves it
KF duplicates no neighbouring program's authority and records who owns each fact
The forced-RLS set is derivable from migrations and reconciled with the database
Business logic is computed by callers and reaches the Fabric only as acts
Dataset, transform and lineage capability, if built, is a core primitive
The deploying organization's identity is configuration, not compiled in
Recording an observation asks the actor for no authority, concurrency or idempotency detail
Capture and retrieval latency are stated as bars, measured, and architectural
An observation is recordable as a draft, attributed from the first moment; promotion is a separate act
Every capture surface dispatches the same acts through the same seam
An agent can act on behalf of a named human, attributed to them, with its participation recorded
A kernel holds the rules, consumers project, callers reach records only through acts; no layer above the kernel can widen what a reader sees
A layer above the kernel writes only as an attributed act, never to storage directly
Each layer reads only what the layer below authorised, and is replaceable without changing the layers below
The retrieval index holds a vector and an identifier, no authorization input, and every hit passes the same grant check as every other read
Retrieval authorization is computed from live records and applied during scoring; no derived copy of an authorization input is stored
A short mask excludes the unaddressed slots; a long mask is refused
A retrieval engine that cannot serve refuses, and a result without semantic ranking says so in the withholding ledger
Near misses are returned only on request, separately labelled, naming the scoring function
Controlled content never leaves the host to be embedded; a non-local provider is refused, and the embedder binding is registered once
The retrieval trace is derived and disposable; the kernel holds the record of what was disclosed as its digest
A stored thing that is neither authoritative nor rebuildable is a transient observation with a stated expiry, excluded from the export, the boundary, checkpoints and long backups
Recorded queries are transient observations; the durable demand aggregate names records and counts of distinct persons, never which persons
What a query withheld is computed on demand at the asking person's ceiling, never persisted, and disclosed to them only as one count within their ceiling
A band bitmap or derived scope tag lives only for the life of its process and never reaches durable storage

One list fused from the lexical and semantic rankings by a named, stated method, served beside the exhaustive lexical ranking and the semantic one, each fused result naming where each ranking placed it
Text may transit to an on-host embedder and is never persisted there; a controlled record offered to a persisting path is refused
A derived index never decides visibility from a denormalised copy; the decision is taken against the record in the same statement
One gesture may dispatch many acts; at least one per item, never one covering several
An unverified record is a record under Law 6, attributed from the first moment, exported marked unverified
A projection labels an unverified member and never omits it silently
An unverified record is not citable as evidence
A promotion act records whether the item was reviewed individually or in bulk
Verification is recorded independently of lifecycle state, never inferred from it
The transaction context is written only by the database's binding functions, sealed, and readable only as sealed
The application binds only a principal derived from a live assignment and recorded clearance, and may then only narrow
An application bind requires a current attestation from a separate process that verified the person's token
People, role assignments and identity links are created only through the owner credential; an identity link is revoked only there, as a recorded act with its reason
The database recomputes each audit event's digest and refuses a mismatch
The database refuses a ledger row for an institutional act no live act grant covers, or by a service actor
Every table that enables row-level security forces it, and a gate fails on one that does not
An unreachable attestor refuses a bearer request as unavailable, binds nobody, and has no in-process fallback outside development
Commissioning refuses an access-token lifetime, realm-wide or per client, above the attestation replay bound
The database refuses an application or service write that belongs to no act recorded by the sealed actor; exemptions are declared with reasons
A closed record's identity-bearing fields are immutable for every session, the owner's included
Every relation declares its endpoint types, and the database refuses an edge of an undeclared shape
A backup is taken by a backup-only login, holds every row it claims, and its restore is proven from that login's backup
Delegation goes one level deep, and every new role assignment and project membership ends within 366 days
A recorded query is disclosed only to its asker; another person's replay returns only the aggregate
An export from an earlier exporter of the same format imports, converted as its migrations converted
A process addresses a store only at its declared, bound address, which never changes and carries no credential
A context read is recorded as a disclosure bound to the corpus of the master record that included it at the revision served, or it is not made
Every refusal of a context read is recorded, and one for a record the reader was never shown names no record
"No longer permitted" only for a record the reader's own master record included; every other refusal is one identical not-found
A context source re-checks current authority on every call, refuses a moved record, and serves only a direct loopback caller
One qualification protocol for every person; roles differ only in their pack, and nothing branches on a role or title
A requirement states an outcome and the evidence that counts; opening a document establishes nothing unless acknowledgement is the outcome
Evidence is acknowledged, located or demonstrated, and a mode is never upgraded
The reviewer who accepts the work credits its evidence in the same act; no duplicate approval
Qualification grants nothing and a permission implies none; the database enforces one only where an action declares it
Only a behavioural revision of a requirement creates a gap, and only for the scope it touches
A mandatory requirement names what becomes unsafe, unauthorized or unreliable without it
An unavailable resource or reviewer is the organization's blocker, never the person's failure
